Record an ingest in the audit table

Source: R/md-db.R
md_record_vintage.Rd

Writes one source_vintage row per load, carrying the pin (§4). Nothing else makes a compiled reference explainable six months later.

Usage

md_record_vintage(
  con,
  source,
  version,
  table_name,
  row_count,
  build_note = "",
  content_vintage = NULL,
  content_vintage_rule = NULL
)

Arguments

con

A connection from md_db().

source, version

The pinned source.

table_name, row_count

What was written.

build_note

Free text.

content_vintage

What period the loaded data describes (e.g. "2026-07" for a BMF release whose newest internal vintage differs from its publish date), as distinct from fetched (when we downloaded it) and upstream_modified (when the file was published). NULL falls back to upstream_modified under content_vintage_rule = "published" — a weaker claim, recorded as such rather than presented as equivalent to a measured value. See PLAN.md section 4.

content_vintage_rule

How content_vintage was obtained: "measured" (read from the data itself), "declared" (supplied by the caller because nothing in the data says it), or "published" (fell back to upstream_modified). Inferred as "declared" when content_vintage is supplied without an explicit rule, "published" when it falls back, and NA when neither is available.
